description: Create a Vidu task on RunAPI (image to video). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

audio.description: Generate synchronized audio. False produces a silent video. Declared type: boolean.

callback_url.description: RunAPI customer callback URL for the terminal task result. Declared type: string.

duration_seconds.description: Video duration in seconds. Declared type: integer.

first_frame_image_url.description: HTTP(S) URL of a JPG, JPEG, PNG or WEBP first frame, up to 50 MB. The provider validates the remote file. Declared type: string.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_resolution.description: Output video resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "540p", "720p", "1080p", "2k", "4k".

prompt.description: Optional video description, up to 20,000 characters. Declared type: string.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: image_to_video
